how: `use visa` finds the sub-folder `visa` of the folder given, rule 2 of cli.md 3, which replaces the shipped `visa` for this project; of its manifest `check` reads `name`, `always` and `resources` (cli.md 3, spec 9), so `close` is `always` and `session` a resource (spec 7.2, 8.1). Its functions are `extern rust` on the crate `labcraft-visa`, linked into the application, so they run as the shipped ones do (spec 4.1, as `results_log` of A.4); their declarations are those of `libs/visa`, so nothing differs from the native bodies (LC4005) and the check finds nothing. `visa.open` of SIM::DMM0, which dmm-timeout.toml defines with no latency, opens a session at 0 ms with the timeout 2 s. `visa.query` sends `MEAS:VOLT:DC?` at 0 ms; it is in `faults.timeout`, so it gets no answer (`answer` null, commands.md 7) and the read waits the timeout of the session, 2000 ms, then fails with `io.timeout`, code -1073807339 (libs/visa/simulation.md 4, 5, 6; libs/visa/README.md, Sessions). Its output `text` takes its default value `""` and `session`, named like its input, passes the session through (spec 7.2). `visa.close`, marked `always` by the project manifest, runs anyway, closes the session and passes on the error it received (spec 7.2), so no resource is left open. `err = e3` holds the error, so the status is `error` and `error` repeats it (spec 7.5, 8.2; commands.md 7). Its origin is the node `text`, named by its first output (commands.md 5 and 8), line 8 of the file, path from the root of the project (tests/acceptance/README.md), `callers` empty since it was made in the top-level function (commands.md 5). The run ends at 2000 ms.
